title: SOCIAL PRIORS: DESCRIPTIONS OF AI USERS SHAPE HOW LANGUAGE MODELS TRUST AND COOPERATE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using trust games, common-pool resource simulations (GovSim), generalized trust questionnaires (PI-99), and intent attribution on user queries (OpenSafeIntent) to measure how models prejudge human users' motives (e.g., prosocial vs. antisocial) based on their training data.
